name: Study finds dedicated vision layers can replace a pretrained encoder
title: Study finds dedicated vision layers can replace a pretrained encoder
summary: A controlled comparison of 0.6B to 6.4B multimodal models finds that vision layers trained from scratch match a separately pretrained encoder, and that placing them in the language model's early layers keeps accuracy with up to 13% lower time to first token. Encoder-free models in the same setup need about 3x more training compute to catch up.

appearances.title: Vision-only early layers match a separate encoder
appearances.summary: A from-scratch study of more than 200 multimodal models finds that vision needs its own parameters, not a separately pretrained encoder. Vision-only branches in the language model's first layers match an encoder on VQA and reach the first token about 13% faster.
